scope: Read-only primary-Chrome acceptance of organization-scoped Saved Source recognition after the designated rebuilt extension is ready.
prerequisites: Root confirms the rebuilt extension is ready and grants the primary-Chrome/resource lease. The existing native-0273-reload report describes the baseline environment only; it is not evidence for D22.
Use the already signed-in admin@admin.com account, its currently selected organization, the existing auto local-engine port, and existing permissions. Keep the Store extension off.

Root authorizes at most one new Source: one public Example/IANA page saved through the real Scrape UI in the explicitly approved test organization, which must already be the baseline selection. Before Save, the actual lookup for the chosen URL must definitively show not saved in that organization. If Example is already saved, try the allowed IANA alternative. If both are saved, either lookup is unknown, or the approved test organization is not already selected at entry, perform no write and mark local Saved UI proof unverified. No other writes or any delete are authorized; never work around these conditions by editing or upserting an existing Source.

Before the one Save click, create test-results/d22-source-save-attempt.json as a private mode-0600 durable checkpoint. It must not exist before the actual UI run. Reserve it and fsync both file and parent directory before clicking Save. On success, retain the actual Source ID only if it is observed in the real UI link; keep that ID and organization name out of logs and this report. If the attempt has an ambiguous outcome or checkpoint state, never click Save again.

Do not sign in or out, save any additional Source, delete/edit a Source, create an organization, change roles, clear browser or extension storage, or change settings. Do not navigate to an arbitrary/private URL or record private organization names or URLs.

procedure.action: After root grants GO, confirm in the primary Chrome profile that Matrx Extend is the designated rebuilt development extension. Record privately which organization is selected at entry so it can be restored. Confirm the account remains admin@admin.com, the local-engine port remains auto, the Store extension remains off, and all four optional permissions remain off. Stop if any baseline differs; do not repair it in this run.
procedure.expected: The pre-run baseline is intact and the loaded extension is the designated candidate.

procedure.action: Open Side panel → Scrape. In the approved test organization, navigate the ordinary browser tab to https://example.com/ and use the real UI lookup to confirm it is definitively not saved. If it is already saved, check one clearly public IANA page. If both allowed fixtures are already saved, or either lookup is unknown, stop with no write and mark local Saved UI proof unverified. For a definitively unsaved fixture only, capture it in Scrape, then reserve and durably fsync the mode-0600 checkpoint described above before any Save click. If reservation fails or the checkpoint already exists, stop without saving. Click Save exactly once and wait for a definitive UI result. Do not use another fixture or retry after a timeout, disconnect, or unclear result.
procedure.expected: The single authorized public Source save reaches a definitive UI result only after a definite not-saved lookup. If successful, observe the real Open this Source link and retain its actual Source ID only in the private checkpoint. If the result is ambiguous, no second Save occurs and the run is reported as ambiguous.

procedure.action: Return to Scrape on that same URL and wait for recognition to settle. Observe the recognition/check state and the Save/Saved and Open this Source controls. Do not press Save again, recapture, edit, or delete.
procedure.expected: The newly saved public Source is recognized as Saved and the Open this Source control points to the Source created by this run.

procedure.action: Use the extension's explicit organization picker to select another organization already listed for this account. Keep the browser tab on the same public URL. Observe the recognition UI immediately and again after its recheck settles. Do not change membership, roles, or organization settings.
procedure.expected: The prior claim, local Saved confirmation, and Open this Source target clear immediately. A scoped check runs for the newly selected organization; it reports not saved when that organization has no matching Source, or reports only its correct matching Source if one already exists. It never continues to show the prior organization's Source.

procedure.action: Use the explicit picker to return to the organization confirmed to contain the existing Source, keeping the same URL open. Wait for recognition to settle.
procedure.expected: The newly saved Source is recognized again under its organization, with the correct Open this Source target, demonstrating same-page switch recheck and restoration.

procedure.action: Restore the organization recorded at entry using the explicit picker. Confirm admin@admin.com, the entry organization, auto port, Store-off state, and four optional-permission-off states remain as at entry. Close the panel without saving or changing anything.
procedure.expected: The original baseline organization is selected and all protected baseline settings remain unchanged.

missing_organization_case.instruction: If the actual UI reaches a missing/unreadable organization state without clearing or editing storage, observe whether Scrape shows a plain-language choose-organization remedy and no Saved claim. Otherwise mark this case unverified. Do not manufacture the state by clearing storage, signing out, or injecting session state.

evidence_to_record: Actual Chrome profile and extension version/build identity as shown in the UI, plus run time.
Pass/fail/unverified for each step, with sanitized observations limited to generic labels such as entry organization and comparison organization.

Whether the allowed public fixture lookup definitively showed not saved before any write and whether the single authorized Save had a definitive success, refusal, or ambiguous result; do not include its URL, Source id, or private organization names in this report.
Checkpoint reservation and durability completed before the Save click; actual Source ID, if observed, stays only in the private checkpoint and never in logs or this report.
Any deviation or unexpected write prompt; cancel it and stop the affected step without confirming a mutation.

limits: No UI/browser action was performed while preparing this checklist, and the future-run checkpoint has not been created.
